visual_lock.label: Doodle stickman Nguệch Ngoạc (giữ phong cách hiện tại, biểu cảm mạnh hơn)
visual_lock.cast_appearance: Iconic 2D Vietnamese indie webcomic doodle stickman (Nguệch Ngoạc / Vẽ Vời / Xấu Vê Nờ style): oversized slightly lopsided hand-drawn pure-white (#FFFFFF) bald circle head with bold pitch-black (#000000) marker outline, tiny solid-black dot eyes placed low on the face leaving a large open upper forehead/cranium, minimal single-stroke eyebrows and mouth, no nose or ears, thin single-line solid-black wire/stick arms (single black stroke with zero arm thickness) ending in small round white circle hands

voice_lock.speaker: VietNarrator
voice_lock.persona: Người bạn thân hiểu tâm lý, hơi cà khịa nhưng thương người xem
